component.name: DankFM
component.summary: Miller-column file manager from the Dank Linux Suite

description.p: DankFM is a miller-column file manager for the modern Linux desktop, with list and icon views, git status, trash, bookmarks, and an open-with chooser. It is built with Quickshell, Qt 6, and Go.
First release: miller-column file manager with an embedded dfm binary.
